name: international-patient-summary-app-with-swift
description: Apple iOS app (Swift, SwiftUI first, UIKit as the fallback) that opens and shows HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary documents. Saved on the device only, encrypted (works offline and after a restart), no network; checks documents exactly as the backend service does.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR OGL-UK-3.0 OR CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0

commands.test-app: xcodebuild test -project IPSApp.xcodeproj -scheme IPSApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro Max' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO

Specification.name: Spec §1
Specification.description: Purpose, and the ideas taken from MyIPS

Specification.name: Spec §4
Specification.description: List, summary and About screens (M-LIST, M-VIEW, M-ABOUT), tablets and folding (M-TAB), people: families and carers (M-PEOPLE)

Specification.name: Spec §8
Specification.description: Stack, architecture, platform notes (iPhone Duo, people), screenshots (newest runtime and iPhone)

Core.name: Check
Core.description: M-CHECK-1/2: Refusal codes and pointers, the service's S-API-2

Core.name: JSON
Core.description: RFC 8259 values with clinical number lexemes preserved exactly

Core.name: Absent
Core.description: none known, not recorded, unavailable, omitted

Core.name: Format
Core.description: displayOf, names, strict dates and ages, exact-token quantities, narrative as plain text

Core.name: People

Core.name: DocumentFile
Core.description: size-first, capped reads for import, drop and Open in

Core.description: M-STORE-1..5: AES-256-GCM sealed summaries and index; retryable writes and temporary-access preservation; StoreKeys

Core.name: TemporaryShare
Core.description: Isolated directory per JSON or PDF export, with per-share and relaunch cleanup (M-PRIV-1, M-PDF-3)

Core.name: PDFPlan

App.name: KeychainKeys
